temporalBoundaries.rule: M01 session may span days and pause/resume; one session carries one learning loop
M04 is per-round, in-session, continuously revisable
M10 is in-session; controls slope/intensity, never acceptance range or route
M15 is cross-session/recent; frequency lower than M04 and higher than M09; event-trigger plus session-close is provisional
M05 is cross-session route planning; M09 is asynchronous and receives only closed loops
M04->M09 is the sole close transition; in-progress forgetfulness is candidate, closed-loop submission is record
M04 threshold submodule and M15 state-stage submodule are symmetric but independent; no pressure scalar
M09 history is append-only/versioned; FHIR _history conditional selection; old visibility and single-vs-bitemporal axes unresolved

crossChecks.round1_senderToReceiver: R01-R76 checked against receiver input/boundary. M04->M15 narrowed to request-only; M14/M09->M08 both require candidate audit; M07/M08 bidirectional edges preserve distinct ownership.
crossChecks.round2_receiverToSender: All declared inputs have a producing source except direct M10->M09, which is recorded as conflict C01 and prohibited; M13 model/service status is cross-cutting because M12 is cancelled.
hiddenDirectEdges: M02/M03/M14->M09 prohibited; M10->M09 prohibited; M09<->M15 prohibited; M04->M08 direct write prohibited
timeScopeLeaks: M04 in-session forgetting cannot directly become M09 record
M15 cannot read M04 knowledge conclusions
M10 cannot turn intensity adjustment into route fork
crossChecks.undeclaredLoops: Only declared loops remain: M02/M03->M04->M10->M02/M03; M08/M09 candidate recursion; M04->M15 request-triggered reconfirmation.
